notes.title: Announcement for Owners of “Don’t Look Back” and Future Releases
notes.notes:
Thank you all for buying my game. It means a lot to me considering that this is my first game ever released. If there are any bugs or problems in “Don’t Look Back”, please notify me about them and I will have it fixed very soon. This is the first game I have made but it is not the last. I have planned four games to be, hopefully, released during either late 2018 or early 2019. 

The first of the 4 games is called Elizabeth, a horror game where you are placed in the role of a girl named Annie who must survive from a murderous doll named Elizabeth. It is currently in alpha and I will have a few people test it later on.

The second game that will be available in the future is called Sketchbook Museum. This is game where you can recreate up to 45 famous pieces of art. The concept for this game was given to me by a friend who enjoys drawing daily.

The third and fourth games will be VR games, (Sorry for those without the headsets). The first VR game will be a Star Wars battle royale pitting you against 10 well known Star Wars characters such as Luke Skywalker, Emperor Palpatine, Darth Vader, my favorite, and more. The fourth game will be one that takes place in one of my favorite animes. Not to give too many hints, but there will be a lot of naked humanoid giants walking around so be prepared.

Now to conclude this announcement, I want to give my thanks again to the people who spent time playing my game. It means a lot to me. I will continue updating you all on major news for the future releases.
